detail: Continuous rain overnight has flooded the low section of Aro Street outside the community hall. Water is ankle deep and rising.
Bank above Aro Street has slipped following the flooding. Loose clay and debris now blocking half of the footpath.
Strong northerly gusts overnight have brought down several fence panels and outdoor furniture across properties on Curtis Street.
Tap water from the mains on Tinakori Road has a strong chlorine smell and slightly cloudy appearance since yesterday.
Stormwater drains on Childers Terrace have overflowed after heavy rain. Water is pooling across the intersection near the shops.
Grass verge along Childers Terrace has given way after the flooding. Soft mud now spilling onto the road.
Deep pothole has formed on Riddiford Street outside the medical centre, causing vehicles to swerve suddenly into oncoming traffic.
Makara Stream has burst its banks near Makara Road, flooding several sections of the road and nearby paddocks.
Hillside next to Makara Road has slipped after the stream flooding. Rocks and soil now covering one lane.
Large macrocarpa tree on the boundary of Anderson Park is leaning heavily after recent winds and looks close to falling onto the playground.
Footpath slabs on Willis Street have cracked and lifted, creating a tripping hazard outside the pharmacy.
Southerly storm has brought hail and gale-force wind through the CBD. Several shopfront awnings on Cuba Street have been damaged.
